dish.n: Mine canteen jam roly-poly and custard
dish.note: Jam rolled in soft pastry, baked and sliced, with hot custard.
dish.how: Rub 100g cold butter into 250g self-raising flour, mix in 1 tbsp sugar and about 120ml milk to a soft dough, and roll to a 25 x 30cm rectangle. Spread with 150g raspberry jam leaving a 2cm edge, roll up and wrap loosely in baking paper and foil. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Heat 500ml milk with 2 tbsp custard powder and 3 tbsp sugar, whisking until thick, and pour over thick slices.

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour and sugar and mix in enough milk for a soft dough.
Roll out, spread with the jam, roll up and wrap in baking paper and foil.
Heat the milk, custard powder and sugar, whisking until thick.
Slice the roll and pour custard over.

dish.make_ahead: Roll and wrap up to 4 hours ahead; bake just before dinner
